verdict.summary: Round 2 confirms the prior approval. The six cache slots are indexed consistently with the fieldless Perm discriminants; SPO remains an allocation-free alias while other projections are lazily sorted and binary-searched. apply_delta invalidates every materialized projection before any non-empty mutation, including pending-insertion retraction, and cloned OnceLock values remain valid for their cloned added vectors. The tests exercise real scan and estimate paths across planner-selected permutations, warm non-SPO caches, then witness both growth and shrink invalidation against rebuilt stores; they are not vacuous. Heap accounting includes materialized projection capacities, and the feature-off declaration accurately records the always-compiled wasm impact. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect was found.
